title: Rain, Rain, Go Away | Kids Song & Nursery Rhymes for Toddlers | BuBu TV - English
description:
A cheerful English nursery rhyme about rain, puddles and rainbows for little ones.
Little Arthur wants to play, so the rain is asked to go away and come back another day.
Sing along with splish and splash, and enjoy this kids song for toddlers and preschoolers.

Rain, rain, go away
Come again another day
Little Arthur wants to play
Dark clouds rumble, thunder roars
Drops go splish and drops go splash
Kids dance out with umbrellas wide
Paper boats go sailing by
Frogs jump high and croak hello
Peacock spreads his colours bright
Rain, rain, go away
Come again another day
Sun peeps out, a rainbow glows
Wet and happy, splish and splash
Mum is calling, come on in
Little drops go pitter-patter
Rain, rain, go away
Come again another day
Little Arthur wants to play
Mum is calling, hooray, hooray
